verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs list importing data from other services into Linear, the official repo README describes import tooling for uploading from other systems, and the integrations directory offers a Jira-to-Linear transition path. A community user also reports migrating a team from Jira to Linear. Missing for 10: which source tools beyond Jira are supported, whether a PM can run the import in the app without developer tooling, what data carries over (history, attachments, custom fields), and hands-on evidence that the import tooling itself works well.
